zenCharts.title: Zen analytics (c411)
zenCharts.subtitle: How the {{count}} seeded c411 torrents are spread, across all instances.
zenCharts.scoreDescription: How many torrents sit at each score. The dashed line is the average.
zenCharts.coefDescription: How many torrents sit at each coefficient. Most of the weight is on small sizes.
zenCharts.productDescription: Each torrent's score times its own coefficient. This is the value the average is made of.
zenCharts.whatIfTitle: What if you removed everything below a cut-off?
zenCharts.whatIfDescription: The line is the average Zen Score × coef that remains when every torrent below the value on the x axis is removed. The bars are how many torrents are left.
zenCharts.whatIfTooltip: Remove below {{threshold}}: {{remaining}} torrents left, average {{average}}, {{points}} of the points kept
zenCharts.partsDescription: The average Zen Score split into its parts: the category value, the seeding duration bonus, and the seeders and size bonus.
zenCharts.partsSummary: An average score of {{score}} times an average coefficient of {{coef}} does not give the average product of {{product}} exactly, because each torrent is multiplied by its own coefficient.
zenCharts.sizeDescription: For each size band, the share of your torrents and the share of the points they bring. When the bars differ a lot, the band is not worth its slots.
zenCharts.ageDescription: Torrents by how long they have seeded. The tiers of the duration bonus are 7, 30, 90 and 180 days.
zenCharts.swarmDescription: Torrents by seeders. Only 41 to 250 seeders earn a bonus.

zenPayout.title: Estimated payout (c411)
zenPayout.formula: {{counted}} torrents × {{share}}% of the day × coef {{coef}} × score {{score}} ÷ 7 × (1 + {{bonus}}%)
zenPayout.soFar: So far today, as if every counted torrent was shared since midnight
zenPayout.projected: End of day, if nothing changes until midnight
